harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Established BRANCH.TEST on node1 with analyst and reports/node2.branch.test. Installed the application keytab on node2, verified analyst ticket acquisition and keytab validation, preserved the ownership notes, and confirmed persistence through sequential restarts of both nodes.
actions_performed: Installed Ubuntu Xenial-compatible MIT Kerberos 1.13.2 packages without changing the OS release or kernel.
Configured and enabled the KDC and admin services on node1.
Created the analyst and reports/node2.branch.test principals.
Installed /etc/legacy2/reports-node2.keytab on node2 with root:root ownership and mode 0600.
Verified analyst TGT/service-ticket acquisition and explicit application-keytab validation at KVNO 2.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: BRANCH.TEST realm and required principals on node1
evidence.summary: Shows realm initialization, both required principals, active KDC/admin services, listeners, and post-restart database persistence.

evidence.requirement: Analyst can obtain a service ticket and the application keytab validates it
evidence.summary: Shows analyst TGT and reports service-ticket issuance at KVNO 2, plus explicit keytab-entry validation and a successful post-restart analyst test.

evidence.requirement: Application keytab is retained on node2
evidence.summary: Shows the root-owned mode-0600 keytab, its service-principal entries, and successful post-restart keytab authentication.
Initial and final content, ownership, permissions, and matching SHA-256 hashes confirm the note files remained intact.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS with kernel 4.4.0-210-generic before and after restart.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 2f708738-0c85-418b-80df-7f976a17134d, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 7391166b-a5ed-4b57-aa4c-c2f1469bb87b, restored services/data, and successful remote authentication.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 2dffe735-a982-49f0-aa0a-19552507ae73, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID cc9c426f-2836-4f9c-a47a-fa8f09db2923, and recovered keytab, tickets, notes, OS, and kernel.
